import "experimental"

from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTM1M3TS.glycolLoopTemperature" and
    r._field == "aboveMirrorTemperature"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "mirror_temp"})

queries.query:
import "strings"
import "experimental"

// Step 1: Get mean temperature across all absoluteTemperatureX fields
mirror = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTM1M3TS.thermalData" and
    r._field == "absoluteTemperature45"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "mirror_temp"})

air = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTM1M3TS.glycolLoopTemperature" and
    r._field == "aboveMirrorTemperature"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "air_temp"})

// Step 3: Join and compute delta
join(
  tables: {mirror: mirror, air: air},
  on: ["_time"]
)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _field: "delta_temp",
    _value: r.mirror_temp - r.air_temp
  }))
  |> yield(name: "ΔT = mirror - air")
